title: Evaluation: keep standalone BDD tag lines in prepared testing samples
summary: The review-fixture evaluation harness now keeps standalone full-line BDD tag comments ([FEATURE], [SCENARIO], [GIVEN], [WHEN], [THEN]) when preparing samples, and still strips other full-line comments. Nineteen samples in ten selected testing articles received complete, neutral tags, and the preparation logic moved to Review-FixtureText.ps1.
key_points: The comment-stripping regex keeps full-line comments that start with one of five uppercase BDD tags; other full-line comments are still stripped
Validation fails when a retained tag line contains Good, Bad or anti-pattern, and reports file:line
19 samples in ten selected testing articles were tagged neutrally and consistently across each bad/good pair
Preparation text logic moved to tools/Review-FixtureText.ps1, used by the harness and its regression check
Scorer, oracle, keepComments, neutralization and manifest are unchanged
